title: Copperton Meeting
motion: to hold a Work Session on the first Wednesday of every month at 6:30 with an anchor location and a virtual option. The meeting would only be used to discuss law enforcement services

title: Copperton Meeting
motion: to form a steering committee comprised of Copperton citizens and at least two council members for the purpose of researching law enforcement needs, future taxing authority, and future legislation. The committee shall meet at least once a month
